Messages.Author: Chris
Messages.Body:
Is the blood put on an uncontrolled vampire by the Tomb of Rameses III
considered a transfer? i.e. if a vampire has the tomb and somebody plays
brainwash on her, when I make a transfer to an other vampire do I still
"move one counter from the blood bank to this vampire"? Thanks in
advance.

Chris

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Chris <SCA....@worldnet.att.net> writes:

>Is the blood put on an uncontrolled vampire by the Tomb of Rameses III
>considered a transfer? i.e. if a vampire has the tomb and somebody plays
>brainwash on her, when I make a transfer to an other vampire do I still
>"move one counter from the blood bank to this vampire"? Thanks in
>advance.

No, it is not a transfer. Transfers are imaginary counters that you
spend in order to move blood from your pool to a vampire or vice versa.
Any other mechanism involving the movement of blood is not considered
a transfer.

The Tomb isn't worded precisely enough in this respect (no surprises here),
but still only counts blood moved to a vampire via transfers.

So, while you can't transfer blood (to use the Tomb's sloppy terminology)
to the Brainwashed Entombed vampire, blood you transfer to other vampires
is matched by the blood bank to the Brainwashed Entombed vampire.
